name: Tommy Oliver (Green)
reason: Rita's evil Sixth Ranger who nearly beat the team alone, then became the Dragonzord pilot and an all-time fan favorite. Near-perfect across the board.

name: Tommy Oliver (White)
reason: Became team leader with the Falconzord and Saba. Combat and leadership at the top, a notch below Green on pure iconic status.

name: Andros
reason: Space-born Red with a personal mission to rescue his sister Karone. Strong leader and a clear arc.

name: Jason Lee Scott
reason: The original Red Ranger and a strong martial artist. Iconic maxed because every Red after him follows his template.

name: Eric Myers (Quantum)
reason: Wes's rival who grows into an ally. Strong fighter with a redemption arc.

name: Kimberly Hart
reason: Top-tier fighter (gymnast background) with memorable Zords. Iconic as the original Pink Ranger.

name: Mike Corbett (Magna Defender)
reason: Fights like a tank, and his arc from revenge to redemption is among the best in the franchise.

name: Merrick Baliton (Lunar Wolf)
reason: Cursed knight who atones as the Lunar Wolf Ranger. Strong combat and a high arc score.

name: Ryan Mitchell (Titanium)
reason: Mystery Sixth Ranger with a family-driven arc.

name: Psycho Pink
reason: Stands out among villains for destroying a Ranger, so combat and iconic score high for a Dark entry.

name: Billy Cranston
reason: Weak fighter, but he is the team's inventor and heart. Arc and Iconic are high because of his character, not his combat.
